name: ES: weak-day long
why: A weak close forces de-risking (vol-targeting funds, margin, stops); dealers and dip buyers absorb it and the next session mean-reverts, most in fearful (high VIX) regimes where forced selling overshoots. ES version, pre-registered 2026-10-17 (research/preregistered/2026-10-17_more_trades.md).
